name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri Volkov's fascination with motorsport began during his childhood, watching rally races in the remote regions of Russia. He channeled his passion into practical skills, earning a degree in mechanical engineering and specializing in precision machining. Before joining Century Motorsport, Dimitri honed his craft at a high-end automotive workshop, where he worked on restoring classic cars and fabricating custom parts. He approaches his work with meticulous attention to detail, believing that even the smallest component can make a significant difference in performance.

At Century Motorsport, Dimitri's calm and analytical nature has made him a valuable asset. He excels at troubleshooting complex mechanical issues and developing innovative solutions to improve the team's performance. Dimitri is particularly adept at working with composite materials and has a knack for finding ways to lighten components without sacrificing strength. He also enjoys mentoring junior members of the team, sharing his knowledge and expertise to foster a culture of continuous improvement. Dimitri is not just a machinist; he's a dedicated craftsman with a deep appreciation for the art and science of motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed, with a slight wave
physical.description: Dimitri is of average height with a lean build, often seen with a focused expression.

Has a habit of tapping his fingers on metal surfaces to test their resonance.
